name: Proving Grounds - damage that ramps the longer a lock holds
notes: The Inferno-Tower rule shape: EntityState.focusStreak is per-actor combat memory beyond a cooldown, incremented on every landed hit against the same resolved target and reset the instant perception reassigns one. A lone, slow colossus closes on a static turret with nothing else to shoot at, so every hit lands on the same target for as long as both are alive - watch attack.launched's own damage field climb tick over tick in the headless log rather than staying flat the way every other attack on the bench does.
